prompt: Earthrise seen from low over the Moon's grey cratered surface. The Earth fills a quarter of the frame: a half-lit globe where the day side shows real blue oceans, white cloud swirls and the tan Sahara, and the night side shows Europe, the Mediterranean coast and India picked out entirely in red city light instead of gold. The red night and the familiar day meet at a sharp terminator line. Deep black sky. Shot like a real space-mission photograph: fine grain, one hard sunlight source, deep black space. No text, no lettering, no logos.
